title: Auna Announces the Filing of Its Form 20 F for the Fiscal Year 2025
summary: Auna S.A. (“Auna” or the “Company”) (NYSE: AUNA) , a Latin American healthcare company with operations in Mexico, Peru and Colombia, announced today the filing of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) on April, 21, 2026. Auna’s Annual Report on Form 20-F can be accessed by visiting either the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov or the “Financial Info” section of the Company’s Investor Relations website at www.aunainvestors.com . In addition, shareholders may receive a hard copy of the Company’s audited financial statements, or its complete 2025 Form 20-F including audited financial statements, free of charge, by requesting a copy from the Investor Relations team at contact@aunainvestors.com About Auna Auna is one of Latin America’s leading healthcare platforms, with operations in Mexico, Peru, and Colombia.
